title: 批量大小调整步长（预留）

standard.summary: 预留字段，当前版本未实现动态批量大小。此值不会改变训练 batch，只保留配置兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 暂无。需要调整 batch 请在训练配置里直接修改 batch size 后重新开始或续训。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要把它当作运行时 batch 调度；它不会生效。

standard_en.summary: Reserved field; dynamic batch sizing is not implemented. This value does not change the training batch and is kept for config compatibility only.
standard_en.whenToUse: None yet. To change the batch, edit the batch size in the training config and restart or resume.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not treat it as runtime batch scheduling; it does nothing.

advanced.principle: 字段保留以便旧配置继续加载；运行时改 batch 需要 dataloader/梯度累积方案，当前未接入。

advanced_en.principle: The field stays so old configs keep loading; changing the batch at runtime needs a dataloader/accumulation plan that is not wired up.
